item.title: Tensegrity continuum robots enable task-adaptive morphologies for cooperative behaviours
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 11 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01335-4

Saikot et al. present flexible modular robots that combine locomotion and manipulation in a single unit, then physically connect and collaborate in task-adaptive forms to carry objects, cross gaps and navigate challenging terrain.
